title: Vector
summary: A transparent studio for comparing AI architecture patterns under explicit constraints.

capabilities.label: Constraint modeling
capabilities.detail: Set eight named constraints as levels, weighted preferences, or hard requirements.

capabilities.label: Trade-off comparison
capabilities.detail: Compare four bounded architecture patterns with visible scores, conflicts, and contributions.

capabilities.label: ADR export
capabilities.detail: Download a traceable Markdown decision record with the profile, digest, and rationale prompts.

evidence.description: Engine, data, and Blazor component tests cover deterministic scoring, sharing, export, accessibility, and non-claims language.
The Blazor WebAssembly app publishes as static output without a backend, database, model, or API key.
